text: Sorry if this is a silly one, I'm a foster carer and I've had this little lad (17 months) for a few weeks now, so I'm still learning what's normal for him and I'd rather check than lie awake. He's got a temperature tonight, 39.3 on the ear thermometer, I did it twice. Earlier this evening he bumped his head on the edge of the coffee table, cried straight away, a proper loud cry, and after a cuddle he was completely back to himself, toddling about, babbling and pulling everything out of the cupboards like usual. There's a small red mark but nothing else that I can see. On top of that his eczema is really flaring, dry rough patches behind his knees and on his wrists and he keeps scratching at them. He's been drinking his milk fine and ate most of his tea, so no worries there. I suppose I'm just not sure whether the temperature and the bump together are something to worry about or whether I'm overthinking it. Also is there anything I can do for the eczema overnight beyond his usual cream? Thanks and sorry again for bothering you this late.
